after.zh: 红灯既要足够亮，也要呈现红色；只看一个通道容易把白色路灯或暗处的红车混进来。结合通道信息，才能在本关的场景里区分这些情况。
after.en: A red light must be both bright enough and red. A single channel can confuse it with white street lamps or dark red cars; combining channel information distinguishes them in these scenes.

t.zh: 在<level-ref to="4-13"></level-ref>里，一个核横跨三个通道，学会了看颜色的对比。这一关在街景里找红灯：红灯又亮又红，可街上还有暗处的红车、白色的路灯和绿灯。
t.en: In <level-ref to="4-13"></level-ref> one kernel spanned three channels and learned to see colour contrast. This level looks for red lights in street scenes: a red light is bright and red, but the street also has red cars in the shade, white street lamps and green lights.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：只标出红灯。要想的问题：「亮」和「红」，各要看哪几个通道？
t.en: Your task in this level: mark only the red lights. Something to think about: which channels does "bright" need, and which does "red"?

brief.zh: 输入是一张彩色街景，可以从 R、G、B 出口分别读取通道。只标出红灯：又亮又红的地方。暗处的红车、白色的路灯、绿灯都不算。
brief.en: The input is a colour street scene; its R, G and B outputs provide the channels. Mark only the red lights: places both bright and red. Red cars in the shade, white street lamps and green lights do not count.

hint.zh: 一个通道只能回答一个问题。「红」和「亮」各要看哪些通道？
hint.en: One channel can only answer one question. Which channels does "red" need, and which does "bright"?
